name: 1992 Bowman Baseball

cards.player: Bowman Baseball has a clean, white-bordered design. The small bar with the Bowman "B" is simple but has helped make the set instantly recognizable among collectors. Many of the prospects in 1992 Bowman Baseball are pictured in street clothes that were fashionable at the time. This gives the set some added charm, much like flipping back through an old high school yearbook.
